_comment: Example manifest for install-portable.ps1. Two entry kinds. (1) Portable archive: url + sha256 + exe (relative to the install root) - replace every sha256 with the real value from the vendor's release page; an empty sha256 is refused unless -AllowUnverified is passed. (2) source=winget: wingetId + verifyPath (absolute, %VAR% expanded) - for tools with no trustworthy portable archive; verification is the readback of verifyPath, never the winget exit code. Optional fields: assoc (file types the link phase offers), addToPath (sub-path to put on PATH), configFiles ({ destination file name: path relative to the skill root }, written only on a fresh install so a re-run never overwrites hand-tuned settings), altPaths (other places the same app legitimately lives; check-software.ps1 looks there before calling it missing), notes (the known traps for this entry).

apps.name: 7-Zip
apps.notes: Archive tool and the extractor the portable installs rely on. winget entries bypass the scoop route on purpose: a single install path that is itself unverified is a single point of failure.

apps.name: Notepad++
apps.notes: Text / Markdown / code editing. The portable zip ships doLocalConf.xml, so settings stay in the app folder. altPaths covers the winget or system-wide install so a correct install is not reported as missing.

apps.name: JPEGView
apps.notes: Fastest image viewer for large folders. NOTE the exe path: the archive has three top-level folders, so the single-directory collapse cannot flatten it and a bare JPEGView.exe never matches.

apps.name: mpv
apps.notes: Best quality/format coverage. Keys: space, arrows, f fullscreen, 9/0 volume, q quit. Subtitles auto-load from a same-named .srt.

apps.name: MPC-BE
apps.notes: Familiar player UX: playlist, speed (Ctrl+up/down), subtitles (Ctrl+L). A .7z asset needs a FULL 7-Zip - the reduced 7zr.exe has no ZIP codec, so do not assume it can unpack the .zip entries too.

apps.name: rclone
apps.notes: Sync/backup to a NAS over SMB or WebDAV. `rclone mount` needs WinFsp, which DOES require elevation - use OS drive mapping for that instead.

apps.name: TrafficMonitor
apps.notes: Taskbar CPU / memory / network readout. configFiles drops a tuned preset on a fresh install (copied as raw bytes so the UTF-8 BOM survives - this app decides the ini encoding by looking for that BOM). The zip has no global_cfg.ini, so the preset supplies one to enable portable mode.
